div.head: Rect 9, 9.1
div.ab: be wifmonna | metsunge Đeowan wifmen .viii. pund cornes to mete .i. sceap oððe .iii. peningas to wintersufle .i. syster beana to længtensufle .hwæig on sumera . oððe .i. peninga. eallum æhtemannum gebyreð mid|wintres feorm. 7 eastorfeorm. sulhæcer . 7 hærfesthandsul . to eacan heora nydrihte .

Concerning the provisioning of women Bound women [are due] eight pounds of corn as food, one sheep or three pennies as provisions for midwinter, one sester of beans as spring provisions, whey in the summer or one penny. To all bound men are due winter provisions, and Easter provisions, a strip of land for ploughing, and a harvest handful, [and] to each their necessities.

[9] Be wifmonna metsunge. Ðeowan wifmen: XIII pund cornes to mete, I sceap oððe III p.' to wintersufle, I syster beana to længtensufle, hwæig on sumera oððe I p.' [9.1] Eallum æhtemannum gebyreð Midwintres feorm 7 Eastorfeorm, sulhæcer 7 hærfesthand[f]ul toeacan heora nydrihte.
